title: The Start Mod
description: Adds Startermen and a Start dimension to Minecraft
body:
# The Start Mod
- Adds Startermen
- Adds Starter Pearls, an inverse of Ender Pearls which bring hit players to the thrower
- Adds Start Dimension (**WARNING:** Dimension is pure white void. Beware of flashbang.)
- Adds Start Portal
- Adds various blocks, including buildable void blocks
- Adds Stun effect, only used by Startermen

Stun texture made by bartun2010.

Due to the dimension being added via datapack, an "experimental features" warning will be triggered every time on world startup.
